platform: macOS arm64; Homebrew Dart stable SDK

package_boundary.lock_policy: pubspec.lock is preserved if host-owned and must never be created or changed by the spine
package_boundary.valid: marker presence plus dart analyze, direct native test, format check, and direct smoke pass without project writes; this does not validate pubspec syntax
invalid_states: malformed pubspec.yaml remains metadata-unvalidated by the generic doctor and dart analyze
version probe missing, broken, or unrecognized
package_boundary.direct_execution_boundary: dart <script.dart> is read-only for this fixture; dart run performs implicit pub resolution and writes .dart_tool and pubspec.lock, while dart test requires a host-owned package:test dependency

source_roles.runtime_symlink: tests create host/linked-external -> ../symlink-target and require role=symlink without traversal

fixture.manifest_algorithm: sha256(path + NUL + file_sha256 + LF), sorted regular-file paths

runtime_closure.definition: existing stdlib-only profile, doctor, and inventory runtime exercised from a copied library; it earns no skill support claim
runtime_closure.manifest_algorithm: sha256(path + NUL + file_sha256 + LF), listed path order

lexical.producer_candidate: version-gated analyzer tokens/source spans or a bounded Dart-native parser
lexical.final_outcome: durable findings/clean artifact with exact roles and complete, partial, unsupported, and failed lifecycle

semantic.final_outcome: durable map with declarations, resolved references/types, package edges, explicit unresolved facts, and honest partial status

mutation.scope_if_authorized_later: one Dart library move in a disposable copy with import/part and pubspec impacts

generated_unit_boundary.classified_now: generated directory or generic generated-name markers
generated_unit_boundary.rule: do not hardcode Dart filename exceptions into shared inventory; add profile-owned generated globs only with a reviewed schema extension

coverage.reason: Profile, read-only doctor, inventory roles, and native fixture gates do not reach any skill-owned final artifact or mutation boundary.

root_integration_needs: Keep pubspec.yaml as the sole generic doctor marker; pubspec.lock alone is not project metadata readiness.
Add profile-owned generated filename globs before excluding *.g.dart or *.freezed.dart outside generated directories.
Publish router, matrix, catalog, and execution-plan truth only after focused skill final outcomes earn it.
